{{Quote|The Rebels have a training droid in Moenia named V3-FX that will train you for Vortex Squadron.|[[Trehla Keelo]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TK">{{SWGcite|exp=RotW|type=conversation|Trehla Keelo|Tatooine}}</ref>}}
'''V3-FX''' was a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] who operated during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], he operated out of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Moenia/Legends|Moenia]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
V3-FX was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="SWG" />
